attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: embeddings-backfill-cron
steps:
  - id: scheduled_trigger
    op: cron/schedule
    params:
      interval: "*/15 * * * *"
      container: wiki
      description: "Trigger embeddings backfill every 15 minutes"

  - id: read_records_missing_embeddings
    op: database/query
    params:
      description: "Read all rules, articles, and SEDs that have no corresponding embedding record"
      queries:
        - name: rules
          sql: >
            SELECT r.* FROM rules r
            LEFT JOIN embeddings e ON e.record_type = 'rule' AND e.record_id = r.id
            WHERE e.id IS NULL
        - name: articles
          sql: >
            SELECT a.* FROM articles a
            LEFT JOIN embeddings e ON e.record_type = 'article' AND e.record_id = a.id
            WHERE e.id IS NULL
        - name: seds
          sql: >
            SELECT s.* FROM seds s
            LEFT JOIN embeddings e ON e.record_type = 'sed' AND e.record_id = s.id
            WHERE e.id IS NULL
    output: records_without_embeddings

  - id: filter_missing_embeddings
    op: data/filter
    params:
      input: "{{ records_without_embeddings }}"
      condition: "record has no corresponding embedding"
      merge_collections:
        - source: rules
          record_type: rule
        - source: articles
          record_type: article
        - source: seds
          record_type: sed
    output: filtered_records

  - id: generate_and_store_embeddings
    op: loop/for_each
    params:
      collection: "{{ filtered_records }}"
      concurrency: 5
      retry:
        enabled: true
        max_attempts: 3
        backoff_seconds: 30
        description: "Handle AI cold start gracefully (2-3 min startup possible)"
      timeout_seconds: 300
      steps:
        - id: generate_embedding
          op: ai/generate_embedding
          params:
            text: "{{ item.content }}"
            record_id: "{{ item.id }}"
            record_type: "{{ item.record_type }}"
          output: embedding_vector

        - id: store_embedding
          op: database/insert
          params:
            table: embeddings
            data:
              record_id: "{{ item.id }}"
              record_type: "{{ item.record_type }}"
              embedding: "{{ embedding_vector }}"
              created_at: "{{ now() }}"

  - id: log_results
    op: logging/write
    params:
      destination: /var/log/backfill.log
      level: info
      message: >
        Embeddings backfill completed.
        Total records processed: {{ filtered_records | length }}.
        Rules: {{ records_without_embeddings.rules | length }},
        Articles: {{ records_without_embeddings.articles | length }},
        SEDs: {{ records_without_embeddings.seds | length }}.
        Timestamp: {{ now() }}
